title: Remove Stones to Minimize the Total
goal: Minimize remaining stones after exactly k removals.
strategy: Each operation removes floor(pile/2). A largest pile offers the greatest immediate reduction, so repeatedly select a maximum and replace it with ceil(pile/2).
